author: Inside Edition
description: It was big news earlier this year when seven-year-old Joey Evermore became the youngest person ever to climb the forbidding El Capitan peak in Yosemite National Park. But now there's controversy after it’s been reported that people called child protective services (CPS), questioning dad Joe Evermore’s parenting skills and alleging he endangered his son. CPS declined to investigate the claims stating they did not meet its criteria. Joe and Joey are speaking with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Child Protective Services Were Called On Dad Of Young El Capitan Climber

author: Inside Edition
description: Keegan Allen rose to fame as Toby Cavanaugh on the popular TV show "Pretty Little Liars." But a recent video shows Allen's face covered in blood. It's not makeup for a new role. Allen says he was randomly attacked by two masked assailants near a market in West Hollywood, and his watch was stolen. He's hoping video from the scene will help law enforcement catch the attackers. Inside Edition's Jim Moret reports.
title: 'Pretty Little Liars' Star Bloodied In West Hollywood Attack

author: Inside Edition
description: Tough travel decisions are being made by families as the holiday season approaches. With air fares at record highs, Los Angeles parents Jeremy Jenkins, and his wife Ashley, have nixed the idea of flying off for Thanksgiving and Christmas. Instead, they have decided to take a family trip with their two kids between the holidays, when fares are cheaper. Sky high fares are being blamed on rising fuel prices. Inside Edition spoke with travel expert Pauline Frommer for tips.
title: Some Families Make Tough Decisions Amid Sky High Air Fares

author: Inside Edition
description: Husbands and boyfriends may want to take notes from this guy. Each day, a police officer leaves a special message for his wife before reporting for duty. The officer looks right into their home Ring camera and tells his wife he loves her. He has been doing this for the last five years. Officer Giovann and his wife Lymaris, who are high school sweethearts and have been married for 11 years, spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Husband Leaves Special Message Every Day For Wife

author: Inside Edition
description: An ambulance was on the way, but officers used their squad car to rush a New York City man to a nearby hospital after he was reportedly shot by ICE agents. Bodycam video shows the NYPD cops lift the wounded man and load him into the back of a cruiser. The NYPD says its officers were not involved in the shooting. Police were called to the scene after an ICE officer reportedly shot a man who was in his vehicle with a 5-year-old child in the back seat. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: NYPD Officers Rush Man To Hospital After He Was Reportedly Shot By ICE Agents

author: Inside Edition
description: The dreaded New York State Regents exams are difficult and anxiety-inducing for any high school student. But the state’s chemistry exam is the hardest. For the past 25 years, no one has received a perfect score at Baldwin High School. Long Island chemistry teacher Anthony Simonelli challenged his students by offering $100 to any student who aced the test. JoJo Yawson, who has learning differences, rose to the challenge and won the money.
title: Student Gets Perfect Score on State Chemistry Exam, Wins $100 from Teacher

author: Inside Edition
description: Legendary Chicago Bears coach Mike Ditka has died at age 86, his family announced Friday. While no cause of death was given, his family said in a statement: "It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of our beloved husband, father, grandfather, and friend, Mike Ditka. While the world knew Mike as a Hall of Fame football player, legendary coach, and leader of the Chicago Bears' Super Bowl XX championship team, we knew him as the heart of our family.” Ditka, who led the Bears to a Superbowl victory in 1986, was also first tight end ever inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame.
title: NFL Legend Mike Ditka Dies At 86

author: Inside Edition
description: Hurricane Isaias is coming, and people in the South are pulling out all the stops to prepare for the storm. In Alabama, Richard Weekley was securing his home. States of emergency have been declared by the governors of Alabama, Georgia, Florida, and Mississippi. Residents have been stockpiling food, water and batteries. Damien Gamble was filling up his generator at a gas pump. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Americans Board Up Homes, Stockpile Supplies To Prepare For Hurricane Isaias

author: Inside Edition
description: When a German shepherd got lost, he did not sit and whimper. He marched his four legs to the local police station. Officers were able to locate his owners, thanks to his embedded microchip, and returned him to his grateful owner. Not long ago, a patrol officer in Florida spotted a German shepherd named Eyore alone on a street, and the pup eventually led cops to his 86-year-old owner, who had fallen.
title: Lost German Shepherd Reunited With Its Worried Human

author: Inside Edition
description: The World Health Organization is calling on Russia to be more transparent about the death of a worker at a lab that studies the plague. Russian authorities have reportedly said the 28-year-old died of 'pneumonia of unknown origin,' but the WHO says it needs more information. The Russian government is reportedly easing precautionary restrictions in the Siberian region where the lab is located. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: World Health Organization Wants More Info From Russia About Death Of Worker At Plague Lab

author: Inside Edition
description: The romantic Laguna Beach moment was marred by a woman's racist outburst.
title: Surprise Wedding Proposal Interrupted By Complaining 'Karen' #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Kimberly Guilfoyle, the former fiancé of Donald Trump Jr., reportedly asked Trump donor Eric Deters to help pay her $100,000 American Express bill in exchange for helping connect Deters with the new Trump administration. When he did not pay, Deters says she ghosted him. Guilfoyle, who is now the US Ambassador to Greece, disputes the authenticity of the messages.
title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Allegedly Asked Trump Donor To Pay Her $100K Bill
